<script type="text/javascript"><!--
/* mt_uni_credit:buy_nav */
(function () {
  var PARAM = 'mt_uni_nav';
  var KEY = 'mt_uni_credit_buy_nav';
  function readQuery() {
    try {
      var q = window.location.search || '';
      var m = new RegExp('[?&]' + PARAM + '=([a-fA-F0-9]+)').exec(q);
      return m ? m[1] : '';
    } catch (e) {
      return '';
    }
  }
  function store(nav) {
    if (!nav) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      window.sessionStorage.setItem(KEY, nav);
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  function load() {
    try {
      return window.sessionStorage.getItem(KEY) || '';
    } catch (e) {
      return '';
    }
  }
  function isCheckoutTransportUrl(url) {
    url = String(url || '');
    if (!url) {
      return false;
    }
    if (url.indexOf('route=checkout/') !== -1) {
      return true;
    }
    if (url.indexOf('route=extension/payment/mt_uni_credit') !== -1) {
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  function appendNav(url, nav) {
    url = String(url || '');
    if (!url || !nav || url.indexOf(PARAM + '=') !== -1 || !isCheckoutTransportUrl(url)) {
      return url;
    }
    return url + (url.indexOf('?') === -1 ? '?' : '&') + PARAM + '=' + encodeURIComponent(nav);
  }
  var fromUrl = readQuery();
  if (fromUrl) {
    store(fromUrl);
  }
  var nav = fromUrl || load();
  if (!nav) {
    return;
  }
  /* Primary: native XHR hook — works before deferred/footer jQuery (Journal). */
  try {
    if (window.XMLHttpRequest && window.XMLHttpRequest.prototype && !window.XMLHttpRequest.prototype.__mtucBuyNavOpen) {
      var nativeOpen = window.XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open;
      window.XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open = function (method, url) {
        if (typeof url === 'string') {
          arguments[1] = appendNav(url, nav);
        }
        return nativeOpen.apply(this, arguments);
      };
      window.XMLHttpRequest.prototype.__mtucBuyNavOpen = true;
    }
  } catch (eXhr) {}
  /* Secondary: jQuery ajaxPrefilter once available (POST body + redundancy). */
  function installJqueryPrefilter($) {
    if (!$ || typeof $.ajaxPrefilter !== 'function' || $.__mtucBuyNavPrefilter) {
      return;
    }
    $.__mtucBuyNavPrefilter = true;
    $.ajaxPrefilter(function (options) {
      var url = String(options && options.url ? options.url : '');
      if (!isCheckoutTransportUrl(url) || url.indexOf(PARAM + '=') !== -1) {
        return;
      }
      options.url = appendNav(url, nav);
      if (options.data && typeof options.data === 'string' && options.data.indexOf(PARAM + '=') === -1) {
        options.data += (options.data.length ? '&' : '') + PARAM + '=' + encodeURIComponent(nav);
      } else if (options.data && typeof options.data === 'object' && options.data[PARAM] == null) {
        options.data[PARAM] = nav;
      }
    });
  }
  if (window.jQuery) {
    installJqueryPrefilter(window.jQuery);
  } else {
    var tries = 0;
    var timer = window.setInterval(function () {
      tries += 1;
      if (window.jQuery) {
        window.clearInterval(timer);
        installJqueryPrefilter(window.jQuery);
      } else if (tries >= 200) {
        window.clearInterval(timer);
      }
    }, 50);
  }
})();
//--></script>
